name: 11880.com

search.notes: Path pattern returned a no entry found page for a fake name. 11880 Internet Services also runs telefonbuch24.de and klicktel.

steps: Contact the phone provider, for example Telekom Deutschland, and ask to delete the directory entry. 11880 says only the provider may change or delete entries.
For data 11880 adds from other sources, send a GDPR objection and erasure request to 11880 using the contact in its privacy policy.
optout.notes: 11880 says it receives subscriber directory data from Deutsche Telekom under the TKG and adds other sources. No removal time is stated.

sources.attribution: 11880 FAQ, Wie kann ich einen Eintrag löschen
